answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock 100 tokens in a vault for 30 days before it can submit one bid per hour, whether it sells meadow forecasts or reef surveys. Creating new keys gives an attacker no free bidding capacity: running 1,000 identities requires locking 100,000 tokens. The defense makes flooding costly through scarce capital and its financing cost, while keeping admission open to anyone who posts the bond.
